subject: The feature 70% of users never tap
preview_text: You probably missed this. It's the one thing that makes Thesis Generator actually fun.
body_paragraphs: You know that sinking feeling when you're staring at a half-finished draft, the cursor blinking at you like it's mocking your deadline? Yeah, I've been there. Last Tuesday at 3AM, I had a paper due in 6 hours and my thesis was a mess. Then I realized I'd been ignoring the one button that could fix everything.

Here's the thing: most people download Thesis Generator, type in their topic, and think that's it. But there's a feature tucked away that 7 out of 10 users never even tap. The ones who do? They're the ones finishing papers in 10 minutes while everyone else is still Googling 'how to start an essay.' It's not fair, but it's real.

I'm talking about the Outline Exploder. Tap that button and your thesis statement instantly becomes a full outline with topic sentences, evidence cues, and even suggested sources. No more staring at a blank page. No more panic. Just a roadmap that writes itself. And when you're done, it exports as a polished PDF that looks like you spent a week on it.

Open the app right now. Tap the 'Outline' tab. Then hit the Explode button. Watch your paper come to life. P.S. If you do it within the next hour, you'll still have time to grab coffee before your deadline hits.
